notes.title_date_page_counts: No page count is identified as such. Dates as written: (1976/77), (1978/79), (1979/80), (1980), (1981), (1981); the first date also appears in the cancelled early A entry. Archive number 12 is recorded only as a comment. No separate manuscript page numeral was found.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No mathematical computation, map, correspondence, or proof check was used. Subdivision decisions follow the surviving local strokes only.
notes.H_collation: metadata.json gives hua_has=nothing and H.tex is empty. Every H field is null and every diff_H is false; no H collation rows were invented.
notes.source_row_accounting: 13 source doubtful-readings rows, 14 local loci. Row 13 is split into 13a (first live subdivision) and 13b (third live subdivision). The notation and abbreviation rows were not counted as doubts.
notes.inspection_order: Clock read at 13:58:25 while loading brief/preamble/notation; packet files then read. Whole scan once, half a once, half b once, followed by 30 distinct crops. No successfully viewed image was reopened. c10 initial call aborted before dispatch and the same file was then displayed once.
notes.crop_limits: c16 retains complete arrows but clips adjacent date/title context; c29 retains complete Découverte and overlaps part of already-settled lower-arrow context without re-adjudicating that arrow. Right-edge crops preserve the available endpoints; no continuation outside the photographed sheet is supplied.
notes.graphical_qualifications: Detached points, residual strokes and small marks are drawn with local unsure wrappers. Confidence in a supported path is recorded separately from unsettled role, hand or surface origin. Ordinary paper texture was not converted into supplied words.
notes.inventory_changes: The archive numeral is now explicitly inventoried. The six-column list is represented by one TikZ figure with positioned text. Existing C inventory labels for pale displaced subdivisions have been updated to match explicit state uncertainty.
notes.structural_validation: Passed direct source checks of braces, environment nesting, explicit math delimiters, permitted macro names, 13 source rows / 14 local doubt loci, source/report candidate synchronization, all 30 crop references, 10 right-edge path commands, and H-null flags. No compiler, renderer, OCR, text recognition, external source, or mathematical check was used.
notes.source_report_sync: The pale first A is placed below the dark A, with the predecessor before replacement in source order. Every proposed text candidate and path component was compared with the current reading.tex before structural validation.
notes.physical_locus_counting: C013.d13a records retained glyph uncertainty without a change; C013.d15 records the additional state alternative at that same physical group. C013.d11 and C013.d13b each combine their glyph resolution with local state qualification. Graphical component identifiers map to explicit paths; source-row totals remain independent of graphical change totals.
